messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service `inference-queue` (INC-2026-0421). Rule: queue_depth > 50k for 5m in us-west-2. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

pagerduty-bot: New page created: https://pd.example.incidents/INC-2026-0421 — Acknowledge to claim.

Lina (oncall): acked. I'm on it. seeing steady queue growth, tail latency spiking to 3.2s for text-generation. All player metrics: 60k queued requests, processing throughput flat.

Raj (SRE): pinging infra console — any provisioning errors? Could be node pool quota. @Lina check cluster events: `kubectl get events -n inference --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 20`

Lina (oncall): ran events, past 12m shows `FailedCreate: Node quota exceeded` and a bunch of `InstanceLimitExceeded`. Looks like autoscaler tried to add nodes but provider returned 403 quota errors. Paste from controller logs:

```
I0321 02:07:42 autoscaler.go:312] scale attempt: desired=12 current=6
E0321 02:07:43 cloudprovider.go:89] createInstance failed: quotaExceeded: requested 4 > quota 2
E0321 02:07:43 autoscaler.go:319] scale failed: cloud API quotaExceeded
```

Emma (infra): confirmed: our reserved spot pool in us-west-2 hit account vCPU quota after a bigger internal job spun up earlier. I'm triaging with cloud quota team now. ETA unknown.

Theo: can we divert traffic to other regions or fail-over to dedicated fleet? We have compatible model variants in eu-west-1 and a low-cost small-quantized variant in us-east-1.

Lina (oncall): short-term mitigation: 1) enable model fallback routing for non-SLA customers to quantized variant (reduce token cost and latency) 2) throttle non-critical background jobs 3) force-scale inference pods to lower batch sizes so CPU/GPU memory is less saturated. I'll start 1 and 2 now.

Raj (SRE): runbook step: if autoscaler fails due to quota, manual node provisioning may work if we use on-demand instead of spot. Lina, want me to kick off `ops/manually-provision-nodes --region us-west-2 --type on-demand --count 4`? That should bypass spot pool quota if we have on-demand capacity.

Lina (oncall): please do. running the fallback routing first: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" https://console/api/v1/route-fallback -d '{"service":"inference","scope":"non-sla","target":"quantized-small"}'` -> 200 OK.

infra-bot: Route change recorded: inference.non-sla -> quantized-small (applied by Lina).

Emma (infra): I submitted support request to cloud and increased soft limits where possible. Meanwhile Raj, I tried manual provision but account-level on-demand limit for vCPU is also near capacity. There is a temporary bump available if we accept smaller instance families. Can you spin 4 x m6i.large instead of c6i.large?

Raj (SRE): doing `ops/manually-provision-nodes --region us-west-2 --type on-demand --instance-family m6i.large --count 4` now. logs:

```
[02:12:58] request sent
[02:13:05] provisioning OK: 4 instances booted
[02:13:35] kubelet joined: node-az1-m6i-01
[02:13:40] kubelet joined: node-az1-m6i-02
[02:13:42] kubelet joined: node-az2-m6i-01
[02:13:47] kubelet joined: node-az2-m6i-02
```

Lina (oncall): nice. autoscaler resumed noticing capacity. I'm seeing throughput climb, queue dropping from 60k -> 30k in 8m. P99 latency down to 900ms for routed traffic.

Theo: quick customer-impact note — public API error rate for text-generation peaked at 6.1% during the outage window, sustained elevated latencies for premium customers until fallback routing applied (~10m). We'll need to surface this to CS.

Emma (infra): tagging incident: impact= degraded latency + transient errors; affected_region=us-west-2; active_mitigation=manual-node-provision + non-sla-fallback.

Lina (oncall): handing off to Raj for monitoring and follow-up (it's 02:25 my time). Raj you own post-mortem + quota request follow-up?

Raj (SRE): taking handoff — I'll keep watch for 30m then transition to infra on-call. I'll open an incident ticket with timeline and action items: INC-2026-0421-POST.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-0421 acked by Lina (oncall) at 02:09. Status: acknowledged -> resolved pending confirmation.

Lina (oncall): adding quick bash commands I used for the record:

```
# fallback routing
curl -X POST $CONSOLE/api/v1/route-fallback -d '{"service":"inference","scope":"non-sla","target":"quantized-small"}'

# manual scale helper
ops/manually-provision-nodes --region us-west-2 --type on-demand --instance-family m6i.large --count 4
```

infra-bot: Reaction :thumbsup: from infra-bot.

Raj (SRE): I'll update timeline in the ticket and ping CS with customer impact summary. If anyone sees queue creep again, call me directly.

Lina (oncall): resolved?: monitoring says queue stable at ~6k and decreasing. marking this thread as handoff/monitoring. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 transitioned to status: monitoring by Raj (SRE).
